courses.title: Class Recording: The Healing Path of Grief & Loss
courses.description: A half-hour recorded class in which Donna talks about heartbreak and loss as part of every life and how to move through grief. Listeners are invited to share their own experience; the video link is emailed after purchase.

courses.title: Intuitive Energy Healing Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one sessions by Zoom or phone that look at the habits and patterns shaping a person's life. Donna draws on guidance from the client's higher self, spirit guides, animal companions living and passed, and ancestors to help them see their purpose more clearly.
